description: This Java source file defines the 'AttributeCreated' event class, which models an event emitted after an attribute of a 'Thing' is created in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for constructing instances, JSON serialization/deserialization, and accessors for event properties.

classes.name: AttributeCreated
classes.description: Final class representing an event emitted after a 'Thing' attribute is created, with methods for creation, JSON serialization/deserialization, and property access.

methods.description: Static methods to deserialize an AttributeCreated instance from JSON string or object.

methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer of the created attribute.
